name: Live Demo Stream
description: Lets a spectator watch a player's view live: points an instance's sv_demoStream cvars at the central demo-stream relay and registers the instance with ql-stats-hub. The relay is one address for the whole cluster, but each game host runs a stunnel client that carries the stream to stats-hub over TLS with the hub's certificate pinned. Set the relay address and the stats-hub in Settings, turn on the tunnel from each host's Demo Stream Tunnel menu entry, then enable each instance from its Live Demo Stream menu entry, which restarts it. The delay stats-hub puts on a streaming instance is set from its Demo Stream Delay menu entry, without a restart. Needs a game server build that supports the sv_demoStream cvars.

host_tunnel.description: Installs stunnel on this host and pins the stats-hub TLS certificate, so instances stream to 127.0.0.1 and the tunnel carries it to the relay over TLS. Changing the port re-runs the setup; re-enable streaming on each instance afterwards so its server.cfg picks up the new port. After the hub's certificate changes, save this panel again with Enabled to re-pin it. Saving with Enabled first asks stats-hub to let this host's IP through its firewall; turning the tunnel off takes the host out again unless the Telemetry Relay is still on. The status shows the hub firewall and whether the hub has a demo-stream link from this host.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Installs and starts the tunnel on this host.

fields.label: Local port
fields.description: Port the tunnel listens on at 127.0.0.1. Leave blank for 27999.

instance_stream.description: Wires sv_demoStream* into this instance's server.cfg and registers its per-instance token with stats-hub. Requires the relay address set below and the Demo Stream Tunnel enabled on this instance's host. Applies config and restarts the instance.

fields.label: Stream this instance
fields.description: Saving with this on wires the cvars and restarts the instance.

instance_delay.description: How far behind the live game ql-stats-hub shows this instance's stream, in seconds. Saving is one call to stats-hub: it applies immediately, without restarting the instance or changing its server.cfg. Viewers already watching are reconnected when the delay goes down. The instance must already be streaming (Live Demo Stream); the badge shows the delay in effect. Needs a stats-hub with the per-server delay API.

fields.label: Delay (seconds)
fields.description: 0 to 300, decimals allowed. Leave blank to use the hub default.

relay_settings.description: The central relay's TCP ingest address. One address for the whole cluster - every streaming instance connects to it.

fields.label: Relay host
fields.description: Hostname or IP the game servers can reach.

fields.label: Relay port
fields.description: TLS ingest port of stats-hub (STATS_HUB_DEMO_STREAM_TCP_PORT on the stats-hub side).

stats_hub_settings.description: Where ql-stats-hub is for registering demo-stream routes. Independent of the telemetry-relay addon's stats-hub target - the two may point at different stats-hub instances.

fields.label: Stats-hub URL
fields.description: Base URL the demo stream registers routes against.

fields.label: Ingest token
fields.description: STATS_HUB_INGEST_TOKEN, not STATS_HUB_API_TOKEN. The wrong one fails silently with a 401.
